issue.title: test_identical_contents_in_two_checkout_paths flakes when detached git maintenance removes .git/objects/maintenance.lock mid-copytree

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by phase sase-1io.7.5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 4) and filed by its land agent sase-1io.7.land.

Fail: Master Gate run 37965408063 at 63a8f7a62e, job 'test (8)' (113938600260, Python 3.12, git 2.55 on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04):

    shutil.Error: [('.../test_identical_contents_in_two0/left/.git/objects/maintenance.lock',
      '.../right/.git/objects/maintenance.lock',
      "[Errno 2] No such file or directory: '.../left/.git/objects/maintenance.lock'")]

Pass: sase-1io.7.5 ran the test locally and it passed on the same tree. The next tip Master Gate runs (37972037950, 37972110667) were green. Fail rate: 1 failure in the ~6 Master Gate runs observed on 2026-10-09.

Root cause (high confidence): `_git_init` in tests/tool/test_observe.py makes commits. Recent git versions run auto-maintenance detached in the background after a commit, and that background process creates and then removes `.git/objects/maintenance.lock`. `shutil.copytree(left, right)` lists the directory, then tries to copy a lock file that has already been deleted, and raises shutil.Error. Under xdist load the window widens.

Fix direction: stop the background maintenance in the fixture repo (for example `git config maintenance.auto false` and `gc.auto 0` in `_git_init`, or `GIT_CONFIG_*` env), or copy with `ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("*.lock")`. Prefer disabling maintenance so no other copy in the file races the same way. Never add a retry.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -n 8 tests/tool/test_observe.py (CI: Master Gate shard 8 on git 2.55)

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1io.7.5 saw this test redden a Master Gate shard during the sase 0.18.0 release push, and no task owns it. The root cause is clear, so it is filed small.
